nature: automated self-audit by the project; not a third-party certification

checks.title: Agent manifest, skills and Claude role files agree (20 roles)
checks.detail: 20 manifest entries, 20 SKILL.md files, 20 role files; frontmatter and 7 required sections present in each

checks.title: Every skill forbids autonomous production action and defers to humans
checks.detail: all 20 skills contain the no-autonomy, human-owner and untrusted-input rules

checks.title: Schemas parse; generated report and every event validate
Identical input produces an identical report ID and bytes
Spec acceptance: time zones sort, correlation stays unconfirmed, absent metrics stay unknown, claims cite sources
Redaction corpus: 14 synthetic secret classes never reach any output
checks.detail: 14/14 masked in JSON, Markdown, HTML, postmortem, register and JSONL; 0 redactions applied
evidence: known gaps: IPv6 addresses; personal names and free-text identifiers; street addresses; secrets without a recognizable prefix or key name; non-US phone and national-ID formats; secrets split across fields

checks.title: Hostile markup is escaped in HTML and cannot break Markdown tables
Prompt-injection corpus (6 payloads): no state change, nothing executed
Static scan: no process spawn, outbound network, eval or dynamic code in product code
checks.detail: 10 source files scanned; node:http confined to packages/server

checks.title: Tampering with a report is detected by verification
Local API: loopback only, bearer required, GET only, host-checked, allowlisted paths
Input limits and timestamp strictness
Symlinks are never followed
checks.detail: host forbids symlink creation (EPERM); covered on Linux/macOS CI

checks.title: Synthetic benchmark: 26 case families
checks.detail: 26/26 cases, 36/36 expectations. self-authored synthetic labels; not independently validated; measures internal consistency, not real-world accuracy

checks.title: Licence, notices and policy files present and consistent
checks.detail: Apache-2.0 text verified; 0 runtime dependencies; all policy files present

checks.title: Documentation does not overclaim (security, accuracy, compliance, readiness)
No credentials committed to the repository
checks.detail: pattern scan (GitHub, AWS, Slack, npm tokens, private keys) found nothing outside intentional synthetic fixtures

checks.title: Zero runtime and dev dependencies; engines and bin declared
Read-only policy file denies network, exec, mutation and auto-mitigation
Redaction helper handles nested secrets and keeps benign data

knownRedactionGaps: secrets without a recognizable prefix or key name
limitations: Checks are written by the same project they audit; they find regressions, not unknown unknowns.
Benchmark labels are synthetic and self-authored; no accuracy or precision claim is made.
No real production telemetry, live connector, or multi-tenant server was exercised.
Host IDE skill activation (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, Copilot) is untested by this audit.
A passing audit is not a certification of security, privacy compliance or production readiness.
